update_types.when: A capability or claim gains new verification
A limitation, hold, or authority rule changes
A meaningful learning closes a cycle
A version is actually available to its stated audience

subject_lines: New evidence in the Living Ledger
sequences.body: This update records one verified change: [capability]. The evidence is [receipt]. It applies to [scope] and does not establish [adjacent unsupported claim]. The next review point is [date or condition].
sequences.scheduled_for: When a verification receipt is approved

sequences.body: We changed the boundary for [action]. Previously: [old rule]. Now: [new rule]. Until the stated evidence gate passes, [held behavior] remains unavailable. No consent or authority is inferred from prior use.

subject_lines: A field note on staying viable
sequences.body: This cycle began with [constraint]. We tested [bounded move], observed [evidence], and retired or revised [instrument]. The purpose remains [purpose]. Here is what changes in the next cycle: [change].
sequences.scheduled_for: Last working day of each month

subject_lines: A bounded release, with its receipts
sequences.body: Cambium [version] is available to [audience] in [environment]. Verified in this release: [capabilities]. Still held: [limitations]. Rollback path: [path]. This message is availability evidence only for the stated scope.
sequences.scheduled_for: Only after source, runtime, and audience acceptance receipts exist
